x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
import math

gcd_xy = math.gcd(x, y)
x //= gcd_xy
y //= gcd_xy

numerator = 1000000000
denominator = 1

if y <= n:
    print(f"{x}/{y}")
else:
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        val = (x * i) // y
        if denominator * abs(x * i - val * y) < i * abs(x * denominator - numerator * y):
            numerator = val
            denominator = i
        val += 1
        if denominator * abs(x * i - val * y) < i * abs(x * denominator - numerator * y):
            numerator = val
            denominator = i

    print(f"{numerator}/{denominator}")
